patterns.statement: Both keep the header to a logo and one button that says Book a call.
patterns.whyItMayWork: With nothing else to tap, a visitor from an ad may stay on the one path the page is built for.

patterns.statement: Both open with a qualifier that names coaches and a revenue threshold, above an outcome headline.
patterns.whyItMayWork: A coach under the threshold leaves early, and one above it may read on feeling the page is for them.

patterns.statement: Both put numbered results with named quotes straight after the hero, before explaining how.
patterns.whyItMayWork: A coach who has paid an agency before may want proof before a pitch.

patterns.statement: Both name three specific pains, each with a cost.
patterns.whyItMayWork: A recognisable moment may land harder than a general complaint.

suggestions.change: Add three result cards, each leading with a number and a named quote.
suggestions.howToTell: Watch booked calls from this page for 30 days against the 30 days before.
suggestions.title: Add a Results section under the hero
suggestions.why: Both other pages prove results before explaining how.

suggestions.change: Cut the form to name, email and revenue.
suggestions.howToTell: Compare applications started and finished over 30 days.
suggestions.title: Try a shorter application form
suggestions.why: Fewer fields may lower the effort to apply.

view.summary: The 2 other pages open with a qualifier and show results before explaining how. Yours makes the same promise but shows no results and answers no remaining questions.
